supportingSources.label: Mr. Pinball Spin Out rule overview

strategy.summary: Complete A-B-C-D at the top to raise the Hole Value. Shoot a Roto target only when it shows a missing number. Then return to top play and favor the lit side Hole Value lanes.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D lanes
quickInfo.summary: Each completed top letter raises the center hole and lit side Hole Value lanes by 1,000, to a maximum of 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Roto targets
quickInfo.summary: The two exposed Roto targets collect the numbers that they show from the seven-number set.

quickInfo.name: Hole Value lanes
quickInfo.summary: A lit side Hole Value lane collects the built value without the direct risk of a center-hole shot.

quickInfo.name: Center hole
quickInfo.summary: The center hole collects the same built value, but its direct shot is tighter and more dangerous.

quickInfo.name: Number Specials
quickInfo.summary: Four consecutive collected numbers from 1 through 7 award Special under the factory replay rules.

steps.text: Plunge through a missing A-B-C-D lane.
Send controlled balls to the top until A-B-C-D is complete and the Hole Value reaches 5,000.
Read both exposed Roto numbers before each lower-playfield shot.
Hit a Roto target only when it shows a number that is still missing.
When both exposed numbers are already complete, send the ball to the top instead.
After most numbers are complete, use top play and the lit side Hole Value lanes for repeatable scoring.
Avoid the center hole unless its shot and return are clearly safer on this machine.

fallback.title: Recovery: A-B-C-D and top play
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the Roto targets, center hole, or side-lane gaps reject shots dangerously.

steps.text: Ignore direct Roto and center-hole shots.
Send the ball to the top through the widest controlled route.
Complete A-B-C-D to raise the Hole Value to 5,000.
Take lit side Hole Value lanes only when upper play feeds them naturally.

alternatives.title: Position play: Controlled center-hole collect
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this only when the center-hole shot is reliable and its return is known.

steps.text: Complete as many A-B-C-D letters as practical.
Shoot the center hole from a controlled flipper.
Return to side-lane and top play after one dangerous miss.

buildsToward.title: 5,000 Hole Value and a useful number set

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D to raise Hole Value to 5,000.
Collect missing Roto numbers only when they face a flipper.
Stop shooting Roto targets when both exposed numbers are complete.
Convert later top play into lit side-lane Hole Value collects.

techniques.name: Curved-plastic top feed
techniques.instruction: Shoot beside an outer bumper. The curved plastic can deflect the ball toward the A-B-C-D lanes.

techniques.name: Roto-number selection
techniques.instruction: Read both exposed numbers before you shoot. Use a Roto target only when its number is missing.

techniques.name: Side-lane collect
techniques.instruction: Thread a lit side Hole Value lane from control, or let a top return enter it. Prefer this collect to the center hole.

cautions.issue: The direct center-hole shot is not worth its normal drain risk.
cautions.response: Use a lit side Hole Value lane or return to the top. Test the center hole only when its geometry is unusually safe.

cautions.issue: Exposed bumpers can send the ball out of control or directly to a drain.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the ball leaves the upper area. Do not assume a stable bumper exit.

cautions.issue: The major shots and side gaps are tight, so misses can return without control.
cautions.response: Test each gap early. Use the widest top route after repeated rejects.

strategy.simpleOverview: Spin Out uses A-B-C-D to raise a shared Hole Value, then lets either side lane or the tighter center hole collect it. Complete the top letters for 5,000, take missing roto numbers only when they face a flipper, and favor the lit side Hole Value lanes.
strategy.overview: Spin Out uses A-B-C-D to raise a shared Hole Value, then lets either side lane or the tighter center hole collect it. Repeat upper play to finish A-B-C-D, shoot only missing roto numbers, then stop targeting the rotos once both exposed numbers are complete. Convert later top feeds into the safer lit side-lane collects instead of forcing the center hole.
